'''Ryan Werntz''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 13 FL from Gainesville, Va. The slot is listed as Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" />

He joined Decipher's volunteer program in April 1996, having directed Magic tournaments before.<ref name="decsq-prof" />
